        About cutting from this page

        Sending needs Chrome or Edge on a desktop and a USB-to-serial adapter on the plotter. Some views block serial access; if Connect is refused, save the cut pack and send the .PLT with your current software, or host this page on your own site and open it in its own tab.

        Drop your plotter's DesignArt profile (for example AE60E.INI, from C:\ANA or C:\WINDOWS) to load its exact resolution, port settings and commands. Inner shapes are cut first so the stencil stays put.
